title: Nightly scan
headline: Two error-level rules fire across the build scripts; nothing else in this sweep is actionable.
synthesis:
## Nightly scan

The nightly sweep ran two external scanners whose severity vocabulary is `error` / `warning` / `note` rather than the levels the app grades with. Nothing here was adjudicated; the rows below are the scanners' own output, grouped by rule.
limits: No triage ran. These rows are scanner output, not reviewed findings.
